page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines; no margin text. Library stamps, shelf marks and a university seal are not transcribed.
page.notes: The Roman numerals in the date are printed with reversed C forms (cIↄ, Iↄ); rendered here as printed, with the date otherwise as MDCLVIII and MDCLIX in the imprint. The imprint year is partly covered by a seal and may be read as "anno clIↄ Iↄ CLIX" (MDCLIX) with some uncertainty. Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is ignored.
